patterns.note: Full-bleed cinematic video or image sections dominate the page, often with minimal overlay text, creating an immersive visual experience.
Extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography is used for key brand elements (HOVN, client names), creating a strong, almost brutalist visual impact.
A high-contrast palette of deep dark tones (near black) and bright white/light grey text is punctuated by a single vibrant, warm accent color (orange) in the footer, providing a clear visual anchor.
The hero section features a parallax effect where the background image/video moves at a different rate than the overlaid large text, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls.
Major content sections reveal with a vertical slide-up animation as the user scrolls, smoothly transitioning from one full-width content block to the next.
Client logos are presented as an impactful, full-width, high-contrast text-only section, emphasizing their brand partnerships with oversized typography.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video or large image that parallaxes against a large, semi-transparent text overlay, creating a sense of depth and movement as the user scrolls, likely using a library like GSAP for precise control.

Content sections are revealed sequentially using a scroll-triggered animation system, where each new content block slides up into view from the bottom of the viewport as it becomes visible, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, maintaining brand presence and navigation access without obscuring content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~8-10x body) contrast with smaller, elegant serif quotes and standard sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp — all corners appear to be 0px radius, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy — generous vertical spacing between major sections, especially the hero and the client logo block, creating a sense of grandeur and allowing content to breathe.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, large-scale typography that acts as a primary visual element, particularly in the hero and client showcase sections. This, combined with cinematic full-bleed video content and a high-contrast, almost brutalist aesthetic for client branding, creates an exceptionally bold and impactful portfolio experience that feels more like an art installation than a typical agency site.
